notes:
You now decide how every clip goes up. Pressing Publish on a clip no longer sends it straight to YouTube: an upload window opens first, with the title, the description and who can see it (Private / Unlisted / Public) already filled in. Change whatever you like, then upload. The Sharing page gained the same description box and visibility picker, and both apply to "Upload now" and to "Schedule for later" — a scheduled upload keeps the values you chose when you scheduled it. The visibility setting in Preferences is still there, but only as the starting value for each upload.

Descriptions are now measured the way YouTube measures them. The limit is 5000 bytes, not 5000 characters; in Turkish or German a character can take two bytes, so a long description could be rejected after the whole video had already been sent. The box now stops at the real limit.

YouTube channel statistics are no longer written to your disk. Subscriber and video counts are fetched only while they are on screen. The connected channel's name and picture are cached for at most 6 hours. Files written by earlier versions are cleaned up on first launch.

The YouTube mark is now shown in its official colours and at its proper size everywhere it appears, with the spacing the brand guidelines require.
